card.name: Last letters of acronyms and brand names
card.fires_on: The final letter or letters of an all-caps acronym or brand name, such as the R in EONR or the L in NINLARO. It fires just before the name ends.

modes.label: Brand name ending
modes.description: The L inside the drug name NINLARO, written in capitals.
modes.example: Increased Mortality in Patients Treated with NIN<<L>>ARO in the Maintenance Setting

modes.label: Acronym ending
modes.description: The last letter(s) of a capitalized abbreviation such as EONR, EoE, LAUSD or ANLL.
modes.example: Illinois Soil Nitrogen Test predicted EON<<R>> robustly to different cost/price ratios

card.plain: It lights up on the last letters of capitalized abbreviations and brand names, just before they finish.
